rics.description: PCE price index- Actual, Chg P/P
rics.meaning: Headline PCE price index, month-over-month change. Released with BEA Personal Income & Outlays.
rics.how_to_use: Sister series to core PCE (aUSPCEMAR) — headline includes food and energy. The 6m annualized rate is what FOMC speakers reference. Spread to core tells you how much the headline number is being moved by energy/food.

rics.description: 10Y Government bond yield as % per annum
rics.meaning: 10-year US government bond yield. The benchmark long-rate for global risk pricing.
rics.how_to_use: Single most-watched US bond price. Decompose into real yield (TIPS) + breakeven inflation. The 2s10s spread is the classic recession signal. Tracks Fed expectations + term premium.

rics.description: Energy Prices, Diesel, average retail price per gallon, all areas
rics.meaning: Average US retail diesel price, all areas. Weekly EIA series, monthly here.
rics.how_to_use: Truck/freight cost proxy. Diesel diverges from gasoline due to refinery yield mix and global maritime demand (low-sulfur regs). Spike in diesel relative to gasoline often precedes goods CPI moves.

rics.description: Energy Prices, Gasoline Regular, Average Retail Price per Gallon, All Areas
rics.meaning: Average US retail regular gasoline price, all areas. Weekly EIA, monthly here.
rics.how_to_use: Most consumer-visible price — moves consumer confidence almost in real time. Heavy contributor to headline CPI (~3-4% weight). Use 4-week change for sentiment read.

rics.description: Energy Prices, Gasoline Regular, Average Retail Price, All Areas
rics.meaning: Average retail price for regular gasoline, all US areas — alternate series matching aUSEPGAPG.
rics.how_to_use: Use whichever has cleaner data. The MoM change feeds directly into the energy component of headline CPI.

rics.description: Energy Prices, Heating oil, average price per gallon, residential consumers, methobrk oct19
rics.meaning: Average residential heating oil retail price, all US areas. Highly seasonal — concentrated in Northeast.
rics.how_to_use: Winter heating-cost gauge. Less macro-relevant than gasoline (much smaller share of budgets) but politically sensitive in cold-weather years.
